title: English Practice Quiz 0802
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: Public Relations and Front Desk 01: A visitor asks for an unavailable employee. You should:
options: Politely offer an approved way to leave a message
questions.explanation: Option A is correct: Politely offer an approved way to leave a message. This is the appropriate professional practice or standard English usage.

questions.question: Public Relations and Front Desk 02: A front desk register is used to:
options: Record visitor details according to policy
questions.explanation: Option A is correct: Record visitor details according to policy. This is the appropriate professional practice or standard English usage.

questions.question: Public Relations and Front Desk 03: A visitor is upset about waiting. You should:
options: Acknowledge the delay and provide an honest update
questions.explanation: Option A is correct: Acknowledge the delay and provide an honest update. This is the appropriate professional practice or standard English usage.

questions.question: Public Relations and Front Desk 04: When answering a business phone, you should:
options: Identify the organisation and offer assistance
questions.explanation: Option A is correct: Identify the organisation and offer assistance. This is the appropriate professional practice or standard English usage.

questions.question: Public Relations and Front Desk 05: Confidential visitor information should be:
options: Accessed and shared only by authorised people
questions.explanation: Option A is correct: Accessed and shared only by authorised people. This is the appropriate professional practice or standard English usage.

questions.question: Public Relations and Front Desk 06: A guest asks for directions. You should:
options: Give clear directions or contact an appropriate escort
questions.explanation: Option A is correct: Give clear directions or contact an appropriate escort. This is the appropriate professional practice or standard English usage.

questions.question: Public Relations and Front Desk 07: A professional greeting should be:
questions.explanation: Option A is correct: Courteous and appropriate. This is the appropriate professional practice or standard English usage.

questions.question: Public Relations and Front Desk 08: If you do not know an answer, you should:
options: Check with the relevant person or source
questions.explanation: Option A is correct: Check with the relevant person or source. This is the appropriate professional practice or standard English usage.

questions.question: Public Relations and Front Desk 09: A queue management system helps:
questions.explanation: Option A is correct: Organise service fairly and efficiently. This is the appropriate professional practice or standard English usage.

questions.question: Public Relations and Front Desk 10: A public announcement should be:
options: Brief, accurate and easy to hear
questions.explanation: Option A is correct: Brief, accurate and easy to hear. This is the appropriate professional practice or standard English usage.
